title.narrative: Preparation of Biomass District Heating Investments in Serbia

description.narrative: The purpose of the Action is of the action is for residents and consumers, as well as the environment to benefit from a climate-friendly, efficient and reliable heat supply provided by economically operating district heating companies. In order to contribute to this objective, the action aims at preparing biomass investments that may be financed as part of KfWs envisaged Renewable District Heating Program (RDH). The RDH program is open to both solar and biomass investments.
